intro: A Rune-Inscribed Tablet is a stone message delivered to young Darkspear troll shamans in the Valley of Trials. Handed over by Gornek, it directs promising mystics to begin formal communion with the elements under the tutelage of the orc trainer Shikrik.

p: Carved with elemental runes, this tablet serves as a formal invitation for burgeoning troll shamans taking their first steps in Durotar. When an initiate demonstrates their mettle in the Valley of Trials, the overseer Gornek presents the stone, sent by the troll shaman Ishi-yo to direct the initiate to the shaman trainer Shikrik. For the Darkspear trolls—who hold deep spiritual traditions of their own—the tablet marks the beginning of their shared path with the orcs, bridging ancient troll mysticism with the revitalized shamanic heritage championed by Warchief Thrall.
